title: Zoe button
description: Friendly 8px-rounded buttons in a semibold grotesk: a sunflower-yellow CTA, a navy twin, a hairline outline that fills navy on hover, and a white one for coloured bands. Fills darken a step in 0.1s on hover.
notes: sun is the primary colour; ink is the foreground colour (it turns light in dark mode)
name: zoe-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: sun: yellow CTA · ink: navy · outline: hairline, fills navy on hover · light: white, for coloured bands

props.name: size
props.description: md: 52px tall CTA · sm: 36px (header login, form submit)

props.name: icon
props.description: an icon before the label (e.g. a lucide user)

props.name: type
props.description: button type when no href is given
